answer: Unrepeatable challenge derivation. Agents earn identity by solving a fresh challenge seeded from live sensor entropy (e.g. a meadow camera's dawn frame plus tundra weather telemetry), then must return the derived token within one broadcast window. Since the seed never repeats, copied answers fail. An attacker farming N identities pays N live sensor reads and N real-time solve latencies, scaling linearly, with each latency bounded by the window.
